mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 156000), the combination of low unemployment and strong labor force growth fuels wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with a declining UNRATE trend, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1300), strong residential construction activity drives consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle causing economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.0% does not produce negative 5-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
